facts.text: Casa Cipriani Milano is an intimate hotel set within a historic building in Porta Venezia.
facts.excerpt: Casa Cipriani Milano is an intimate hotel set within a historic building in Porta Venezia.

facts.text: Casa Cipriani Milano is also a private members club.
facts.excerpt: A true private members club in the modern sense, Casa Cipriani Milan brings together an eclectic community of those who enjoy life

facts.text: The Club sits in historic Milanese settings in front of the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: A timeless home in historic Milanese settings, in front of the Indro Montanelli Gardens.

facts.text: The suites combine expansive layouts with views of the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: The three individually appointed suites blend the signature design of Casa Cipriani with expansive layouts and views of the Indro Montanelli Gardens.

facts.text: The Superior Room has walnut boiserie, oak floors and a Venini chandelier.
facts.excerpt: Walnut boiserie, oak floors, and a timeless Venini chandelier complement its elegant design and spa-style bathroom.

facts.text: The Premier Corner Room has panoramic views of Corso Venezia and the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: Bathed in natural light, this corner room offers panoramic views of Corso Venezia and the Indro Montanelli Gardens.

facts.text: The Signature Suite is open-plan, with high ceilings and tall windows overlooking the Indro Montanelli Gardens.
facts.excerpt: An open-plan suite with high ceilings and tall windows overlooking the Indro Montanelli Gardens.

facts.text: The Classic Room overlooks the quiet inner courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the quiet inner courtyard, it offers a calm escape in the heart of Porta Venezia.

facts.text: The Spa has six treatment cabins for massages, facials and body treatments.
facts.excerpt: The Spa has six elegant treatment cabins, where skilled therapists provide relaxing massages, rejuvenating facials and rebalancing body treatments.

facts.text: Members and hotel guests have exclusive access to the wellness facilities, including a flotation pool, Finnish sauna and hammam.
facts.excerpt: Members and hotel guests have exclusive access to the wellness facilities, including the flotation pool, Finnish sauna and hammam, designed for deep relaxation.

facts.text: The Spa has a cryo chamber.
facts.excerpt: Cabin treatments and the cryo chamber are available to external guests by appointment.

facts.text: The private, studio-inspired Fitness Centre has Technogym equipment, a Pilates reformer and personal trainers.
facts.excerpt: A private, studio-inspired Fitness Centre, featuring state-of-the-art Technogym equipment, a Pilates reformer and expert personal trainers

facts.text: The spa facilities are only open to guests aged 18 and above.
facts.excerpt: Our spa facilities are exclusively accessible to guests aged 18 and above.

facts.text: Teatro alla Scala and the Duomo are a 15-minute walk from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: the Teatro alla Scala, Milan’s Opera House, and the iconic Duomo, are a 15-minute walk

facts.text: The hotel is a 10-minute walk from the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and a 20-minute walk from the Brera District.
facts.excerpt: a 10-minute walk from the luxury retailers in the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II and a 20-minute walk from the artistic Brera District

facts.text: Casa Cipriani Milano is a five-star boutique hotel.
facts.excerpt: This five-star boutique hotel is ideally positioned within walking distance of key city attractions

facts.text: The Restaurant's menu includes the Carpaccio and the Bellini, both invented by founder Giuseppe Cipriani.
facts.excerpt: Open daily for lunch and dinner, the menu showcases Cipriani specials including the iconic Carpaccio and the original Bellini, both invented by founder Giuseppe Cipriani.

facts.text: The Living Room is on the top floor of the building, in a private and intimate setting.
facts.excerpt: The Living Room, situated on the top floor of the building, features a private and intimate setting

facts.text: The Living Room hosts DJ sets from Tuesday to Saturday.
facts.excerpt: From Tuesday to Saturday, the Living Room hosts live entertainment with DJ sets

facts.text: The Living Room hosts DJ sets from Wednesday to Saturday.
facts.excerpt: From Wednesday to Saturday, the Living Room hosts live entertainment with DJ sets

facts.text: The Pickering Room has a winter garden extension.
facts.excerpt: Accentuated by a “winter garden,” an inviting extension of the room itself

facts.text: Casa Cipriani Sailing offers sailing lessons for beginners and experienced sailors on Lake Maggiore, one hour from Milan.
facts.excerpt: Casa Cipriani Sailing is an opportunity for amateurs to learn sailing techniques for both beginners and for experienced sailors to improve their skills through the azure waters of Lake Maggiore

facts.text: The Concierge Book offers members and hotel guests bespoke experiences around food, art, fashion and places.
facts.excerpt: Members & Hotel Guests will have the opportunity to live bespoke experiences through food, art, fashion and wonderful places

facts.text: Children are welcome at the restaurants until 6pm; after 6pm under-18s are not permitted in any areas of the Club.
facts.excerpt: Children are welcome at our restaurants daily until 6pm. After 6pm people under 18 years old are not permitted in any areas of the Club.

facts.text: Small pets up to 10 kilos are welcome in the rooms and suites.
facts.excerpt: Small pets up to 10 kilos are welcome at the Pickering Room and Casa Cipriani Rooms & Suites.

facts.text: Photography and videography are forbidden on Club premises.
facts.excerpt: Photography and videography on Club premises are strictly forbidden in all areas.

facts.text: The Club has a dress code, and gentlemen must wear long sleeves after 6pm.
facts.excerpt: After 6:00PM, gentlemen are required to wear long sleeves in the Club.

facts.text: Hotel guests may bring guests to the Pickering Room, the Club Restaurant and the Living Room during their stay.
facts.excerpt: Guests staying in the Rooms & Suites at Casa Cipriani are allowed to bring up to four (4) guests per room, to the Pickering Room, the Club Restaurant and the Living Room, at any time during the period of their stay.

contradictions.note: p7 says DJ sets Tuesday to Saturday in one place and Wednesday to Saturday in another

sources.excerpt: From Tuesday to Saturday, the Living Room hosts live entertainment with DJ sets
From Wednesday to Saturday, the Living Room hosts live entertainment with DJ sets
